page_title: RSO 1-1 ATM | Real Sociedad v Atletico Madrid 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.

90+5' Takefusa Kubo sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well wide of the left post.
90+2' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Sergio Gomez, but sends his close-range header way wide of the right post.
90+1' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but it's just a bit too high and misses the bar by a whisker.
90+1' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends a low pass from outside the box to Pablo Barrios. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Diego Simeone appears to have said too much and referee Isidro Diaz de Mera comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
88' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
87' A clumsy foul by Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Atl. Madrid.
84' 1 - 1 Absolutely fantastic goal! Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) hits a perfect volley from far out and the ball flies into the top right corner. Take a bow.
83' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Javi Galan will be replaced by Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid).
83' Substitution. Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) has come on for Antoine Griezmann.
82' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' The attendance for today's match is 31983.

82' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
81' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Sociedad are going to take it.
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) meets a cross from Martin Zubimendi, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar.
77' The game is interrupted now, Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Julian Alvarez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
72' Close! Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
71' The total number of attempts is 10:4. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 7:1.
68' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but Jan Oblak comes off his line to gather the ball.

66' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the top left corner. Jan Oblak displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
64' Here is a change. Conor Gallagher is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid).
61' That's the end of the game for Sheraldo Becker, who is replaced by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
61' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
57' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just over the bar. That would have been a great goal!
56' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Remiro, who smothers the ball.
55' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
53' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
50' Alex Remiro steps in and intercepts a long pass from Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid).
48' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
47' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows the whistle, Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Real Sociedad get a free kick.

47' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post.
46' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle and signals a foul after Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) brought his opponent down. It's a free kick to Real Sociedad in a dangerous position.
46' Imanol Alguacil makes a half-time substitution. Brais Mendez comes on in place of Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) sends a long ball forward to Sheraldo Becker, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
43' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) sends a long ball forward to Takefusa Kubo, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
43' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

42' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom right corner as Jan Oblak produces a good save.
38' Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).
38' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

37' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes out for a corner. Atl. Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
34' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
34' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
33' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Real Sociedad earn a corner.
30' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jon Aramburu. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
27' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

26' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Jan Oblak guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
23' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
20' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.

18' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.

13' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper. Jan Oblak makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
12' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
12' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
11' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
9' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
6' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
5' A long pass finds Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak reacts well to make a good save.
4' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

1' 0 - 1 Antoine Griezmann is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom right corner to make the score 0:1.
1' The first half has started.
Atl. Madrid will kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera was nominated as the referee for this game.
